title: The Clocktower Ledger
solution: THE CLOCKTOWER KEEPER HID A LEDGER UNDER THE THIRD STEP. TAKE IT TO THE CITY ARCHIVE BEFORE SUNSET.
ciphertext: MAX VEHVDMHPXK DXXIXK ABW T EXWZXK NGWXK MAX MABKW LMXI. MTDX BM MH MAX VBMR TKVABOX UXYHKX LNGLXM.
briefing: At dawn, the compass points toward the clocktower. Inside its stopped clock you find a second note. Work out where the keeper hid his ledger.
ending: Beneath the third step lies the keeper's ledger. A blue lantern is drawn beside an entry for the city archive. You carry the ledger across the square.
clues: MAX appears 3 times as a whole word. Try THE, then compare the letter pairs with your first case.
This is another Caesar cipher, but the first case's shift will not work. The same alphabet shift must explain every pair.
The encryption shift is 19. MAX reads THE; use the same backward shift for the rest of the note.
